# integrated/puphpet

> 标签: Integrated, puphpet, vagrant

## 简介

Provides a Vagrant box for Integrated applications, based on PuPHPet

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：http://www.integratedfordevelopers.com
- 源码仓库：https://bitbucket.org/eactive/integrated-puphpet.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/integrated%2Fpuphpet

## 获取地址

- Composer 安装：`composer require integrated/puphpet`
